description: ADA Summary Long is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation, published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. This dataset details the total number of Americans with Disabilities Act accessible stations, the total number of non American with Disabilities Act accessible stations, and the percentage of Americans with Disabilities Act accessible stations. The data is from 2014-2024. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). It has 7 columns, among them ada_stations, rail_bus_ferry, non_ada_stations, ntd_id, perc_ada, year. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
